text:
liz: Heads up — partner-alert flagged a blob in partner-logs with a plaintext reference to our kms key resource. Not sure if it's just metadata but want a quick triage.

omar: I pulled the log, looks like an internal ingest debug dump from yesterday. contains: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/pipeline/cryptoKeys/partner-ingest-key in the payload.

taylor: yikes. do we see any associated decrypt attempts from unknown principals? checked KMS audit?

maria: KMS audit shows a handful of decrypt requests 2026-03-21 23:45 from svc-partner-relay@partner. Redacted IPs in the logs. All allowed but the artifact leak could be bad for compliance.

liz: also noticed our vault-audit-forwarder forwarded ~8 of those log lines to external-splunk with the key path in clear. we should treat as potential exposure.

vault-bot: alert: vault-audit-forwarder detected 8 entries containing kms resource path projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/pipeline/cryptoKeys/partner-ingest-key. Marked severity=info -> escalate if external index detected.

omar: what's the scope? the key is KMS-wrapped, but partners could infer naming and attempt brute-force or social engineering. Recommend rotating target key and rewrapping dependent ciphertexts.

taylor: agree. minimal-impact approach: create new key version, temporarily add targeted decrypt binding for svc-partner-relay (so we don't break live traffic), rewrap ciphertexts in vault for partner namespaces, then retire old version. need partner coordination window.

liz: also need to revoke any long-lived Vault tokens that were used by the partner integration last 7 days. I can generate a list from vault audit.

maria: on the RBAC side, I see a recent terraform change that removed a broad group binding and replaced with a narrower one. looks like a diff accidentally removed the partner relay principal for the key. that's probably why some decrypts failed yesterday for a few partners. we need a guard to prevent partial removals of principals on KMS keys in the future.

omar: plan of action: (1) emergency push to reinstate decrypt role for svc-partner-relay for ingest-key (temporary), (2) start key rotation + rewrap for partner-ingest-key, (3) revoke/rotate long-lived tokens, (4) add CI preflight to block partial IAM diffs on KMS resources, (5) redact key paths in forwarded logs.

taylor: I can do #1 now with gcloud. command: 

```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:svc-partner-relay@partner.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter \
  --condition=None
```
will watch for errors.

liz: after that please hold for 5-10 minutes while I validate partner traffic.

taylor: binding added at 11:16 UTC.

maria: partner-ops reports transient failures cleared. good. we still must rotate and close the audit gap.

omar: rotation notes: create new key version and use a short alias switch to avoid updating many configs. Vault's KMS wrapper supports aliasing via keyVersionName. steps: 
- gcloud kms keys versions create --key=partner-ingest-key --location=global --keyring=pipeline
- update vault kms config to point to new key version alias
- rewrap ciphertexts in batches: iterate vault transit/rewrap endpoints for partner namespace, monitor errors
- keep old key version in GA for 7d then schedule destroy

liz: I'll prepare a rewrap script for partner namespace that rewraps 100 ciphertexts/min and retries on failure. we should also expose a dry-run mode that decrypts/encrypts a test payload.

maria: CI gate: propose this rule - any terraform diff that touches resources of type google_kms_crypto_key or google_project_iam_binding must include an accompanying top-level comment listing all principals added/removed and pass a Conftest policy that enforces non-partial updates for keys with names matching ^.*-ingest-key$.

omar: i'll add a pre-merge check in infra CI to run the Conftest policy and a secondary check that scans the PR for 'projects/' key path strings to warn.

taylor: logs redaction: request we add a mask rule in the audit-forwarder pipeline to replace '/keyRings/[^/]+/cryptoKeys/[^\s]+' with '[REDACTED_KMS_PATH]'. I'll open a small PR to pipeline repo.

vault-bot: notice: redaction rule PR created in pipelines/audit-forwarder#321 by taylor. staging run scheduled.

liz: owners: taylor (emergency binding + redaction PR), omar (rewrap script + rotation runbook), maria (CI gate + Conftest policy), liz (token revocation list and partner advisory). please update incident tracker and ping compliance for record.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1355 - "partner-kms-path-exposure-and-rotation" assigned to oncall. impact: low.

maria: timeline: emergency binding done, partner validated, rotation runbook draft in 3 hours, redaction PR to staging in 1 hour, CI gate prototype by EOD. I'll sync with compliance and legal for notification wording.

liz: drafting partner advisory now; will include fallback of 2-hour maintenance window and rollback instructions.

omar: one last item - check our snapshot backups for plaintext KMS paths that may have been captured by debug dumps. if found, schedule scrubbing.

maria: noted. tagging backups team.

liz: thanks everyone. closing thread for now, will reopen if we see any anomalies during rotation. :lock:
